correctness.rationale: For periodic λ(x)=a±b on equal half-cells (a>|b|≥0), constant speed ±v and unwrapped coordinate, the tilted generator is sv(∂+k)+λ(f_{−s}−f_s). Monodromy across the two half-periods uses traceless B_λ(θ)=[[θ+λ,−λ],[λ,−θ−λ]]/v, B²=θ(θ+2λ)I/v². Periodicity gives half-trace F(θ)=cosh(kL), with the exact cosh/sinhc product, and Taylor coefficients F'(0)=L²a/v² and F''(0)/2=L²(4L²a²−L²b²+12v²)/(24v⁴). Analytic implicit inversion yields ψ(k)=v² k²/(2a)+[−v⁴/(8a³)+L²b²v²/(96a³)]k⁴+O(k⁶), so ψ''(0)=v²/a, ψ''''(0)=−3v⁴/a³+L²b²v²/(4a³). Therefore sign switches exactly at L|b|=2√3v, under admissibility a>|b|. The excess-kurtosis leading t^{-1} coefficient follows after normalization and only unwrapped cumulants are claimed. Independently expanded transfer matrix with SymPy for all symbolic parameters and matched both cumulants. Markov phase compactness/positive switches supplies local analytic eigenbranch; no finite-time sign claim.
